q: Which Meta campaigns are wasting money?
answer:
Short answer: These Meta campaigns lost more in ad spend than they generated in order-date sales last 7 days (Tilting Heads). Top offenders (last 7 days, 2026-10-08..2026-10-14, net sales = order date; ad spend = Meta report_date):

- DOG DAD T-SHIRT-CS-06OCT — Ad spend ₹10,233 → Net sales ₹6,126; ROAS 0.6x; shortfall ₹4,108.  
- DOG SHOES-CR-7OCT — Ad spend ₹9,363 → Net sales ₹5,548; ROAS 0.6x; shortfall ₹3,814.  
- DOG TOY CS-10TH-OCT-CS — Ad spend ₹6,334 → Net sales ₹3,049; ROAS 0.5x; shortfall ₹3,284.  
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+ — Ad spend ₹17,476 → Net sales ₹14,238; ROAS 0.8x; shortfall ₹3,238.  
- DOG MOM T-SHIRT-CS-06OCT — Ad spend ₹9,072 → Net sales ₹5,884; ROAS 0.6x; shortfall ₹3,188.  
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-29SEP — Ad spend ₹17,746 → Net sales ₹14,972; ROAS 0.8x; shortfall ₹2,773.  
- TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE-6OCT — Ad spend ₹12,336 → Net sales ₹10,070; ROAS 0.8x; shortfall ₹2,266.  
- TH-068_WILD-12OCT-CV — Ad spend ₹6,729 → Net sales ₹4,743; ROAS 0.7x; shortfall ₹1,986.

Why this matters: each listed campaign spent more than it returned in order-date sales (ROAS < 1), so they are net negative for topline in this window.

Caveats / certainty: ad spend is platform-reported (report_date) while sales are order-date; some campaigns in the paid_media top list had no matching commerce rows (18 of 29 entities miss one side), so this ranking only includes campaigns present in both feeds.

Worth checking: pause or reduce spend on the top 3 listed, or drill into their creative/targeting/landing pages and recent budget/bid edits before reallocation.

Period: 2026-10-08..2026-10-14 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-15
